title: 第289章 痴翁裂石驯惊雷，困客窃药觉杀机
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

汉子仰天的一通癫笑，听得围观众人头皮发麻。

人群却不由自主地朝里涌。

“退后！退后！”

几个铁骊卫兵横起长枪，将拥上来的人潮死命往后逼。

“都不要命了是不是？”

一名卫兵唾沫横飞，骂道，“一个个的，都想跟着他儿子，去见山神？”

“往后站！”

人群这才悻悻退开半步。

石院门口，卫兵队长按着腰刀，冲院里披头散发的汉子怒喝。

“石聋子！你个老东西，发的哪门子疯！弄出这么大的动静！”

“再炸。”

队长一指塌了半边的院墙，道，“老子拆了你这破院子！”

正闹着，屋里跑出来一个十一二岁的女娃。

女娃生得瘦瘦小小，一身打了补丁的旧衣裳。

“军爷！军爷息怒！”

她几步抢到队长面前，连连作揖，道，“我这就把他弄进去，您别动气！”

说着，她转身奔到疯癫汉子身边，伸出两只小手，死命去拽。

“爷！别比划了，跟我进屋！”

石聋子却恍若未闻。

他一把抓住女娃的胳膊，指着满地碎石，两眼放光。

“乌妮！你看见了没！成了！成块地崩开了！哈哈！”

“看见了，看见了！”

女娃一边哄，一边拽，一副小大人的模样，道，

“你厉害！天底下数你最厉害！快进屋，我来收拾！”

“等一下，我再看看！”

石聋子挣开乌妮的手，竟又蹲下身，捡起一块碎石，翻来覆去地端详。

卫兵队长瞧着这一老一小，无奈地摇了摇头。

“看你个够！”

他一摆手，冲手下吆喝，“没伤着人，都散了吧！”

几个铁骊卫兵见没闹出大事，骂咧咧地收了长枪，退了开去。

人群却没散。

三三两两地围在塌墙外头，七嘴八舌地议论起来。

“这乌妮，可怜哟。”

一个老者压低声音，道，“她娘生她时难产没的，还不满周岁，她爹也没了。这么点大的娃，倒要反过来照应这疯老头子。”

“还不都怪这石聋子！”

一个面相刻薄的妇人尖着嗓子，道，“当年就是他鬼迷心窍，弄这邪门歪道去崩山。山没崩开，倒触了山神的怒，半空里掉下块大石头，活活把他亲儿子砸死了！”

“依我看哪，是山神本要收了他这老不死的。”

旁边一人接茬，啧啧道，“是他儿子替他挨了那一下，挡了灾。”

院门口，女娃猛地回过头。

她叉起腰，瘦小的身子挡在门前，冲着人群嚷了起来，

“又没崩着你们！提我爹作甚！”

“再嚼舌根，小心我爹把你们都带去见山神！”

“哟，你瞧这小狐狸精。”

刻薄妇人毫不示弱，啐了一口，道，“跟你那短命娘，一个媚样！我看呐，你爹你娘，就是叫你这小扫把星给克死的！”

“下一个，我就克死你！”

女娃红着眼眶，毫不退让。

“都给老子滚远点！”

人群后头，忽地走出一个汉子。

来人身材壮实，穿着一身铁骊军的皮甲，面色冷沉。

“走走走！没你们看的热闹！”

围观众人一见这汉子，神色皆是一变，再不敢多嘴，纷纷散去。

女娃一见来人，那张绷得死紧、还满是嗔怒的小脸，倏地就软了下来。

眼圈，也跟着红了。

“哈古叔……”

“我才回城，在城外就听见动静了。”

哈古沉着脸，大步迈进院子。

他走到石聋子身旁蹲下，也顺手捡起一块碎石。

“师父！您怎么又崩上石头了？”

哈古的声气里带着几分恼，道，“您不是答应过我，再不碰这东西了么？”

“你看，我成了！”

石聋子像是压根没听见他在说什么，只顾举着手里碎石，冲他大喊。

“成了也没用！”

哈古把手里的碎石一搁，一字一句道，

“山有骨，石有魂，一錾一錾敬山神。敬三分，让一寸，取一块，谢一恩。这不是您一句一句教给我的吗？”

“用火药硬崩山骨，是要触怒山神的！”

Page (1/3)

The man looked up to the sky and laughed like crazy, which made everyone in the audience feel numb.

The crowd surged involuntarily.

"Back off! Back off!"

Several Tieli guards raised their spears and pushed the crowd back.

"You don't even care about your life, do you?"

One of the guards spat and cursed, "Everyone wants to follow his son to meet the mountain god?"

"Stand back!"

The crowd then took half a step back angrily.

At the entrance of the stone courtyard, the guard captain held his sword and shouted angrily at the disheveled man in the courtyard.

"Shi Deaf! You old guy, how crazy are you! You made such a big noise!"

"Blow it up again."

The captain collapsed half of the courtyard wall with one finger and said, "I'll demolish your lousy courtyard!"

While they were making a fuss, an eleven or twelve-year-old girl ran out of the house.

The girl was born thin and small, wearing old patched clothes.

"Master Jun! Master Jun, calm down!"

She rushed to the captain in a few steps, bowed repeatedly, and said, "I'll get him in right now, don't be angry!"

As she said that, she turned around and ran to the crazy man, stretched out her two little hands, and tried to pull him hard.

"Master! Stop gesticulating and come into the house with me!"

Deaf Shi seemed to have not heard anything.

He grabbed the girl's arm and pointed at the gravel on the ground, his eyes shining.

"Wuni! Did you see it? It's done! It collapsed in pieces! Haha!"

"I saw it, I saw it!"

The girl coaxed and pulled her, looking like a little adult, and said,

"You are great! You are the most powerful in the world! Come into the house and I will take care of it!"

"Wait a minute, I'll take a look again!"

Deaf Shi broke away from Wu Ni's hand, squatted down, picked up a piece of gravel, and looked at it over and over.

The captain of the guard looked at the old and the young and shook his head helplessly.

"It's enough for you!"

He waved his hand and shouted to his men, "No one was hurt, just disperse!"

Seeing that there was no big trouble, several Tieli guards put away their spears and retreated.

The crowd did not disperse.

People in twos and threes gathered outside the collapsed wall, talking in all directions.

"This Wu Ni is so pitiful."

An old man lowered his voice and said, "Her mother had a difficult delivery when she was born. She was not yet one year old, and her father is gone too. For such a big baby, she has to take care of this crazy old man."

"It's not all the blame on this deaf man!"

A woman with a mean face said in a shrill voice, "It was him who was so obsessed with it that he came up with this evil way to collapse the mountain. The mountain did not collapse, but he provoked the wrath of the mountain god. A big stone fell from the air and killed his own son!"

"In my opinion, it was the mountain god who wanted to accept this old immortal."

A person next to him continued, tut-tutting, "It was his son who took that blow for him and prevented the disaster."

At the entrance of the courtyard, the girl turned her head sharply.

She put her hands on her hips, blocked the door with her thin body, and shouted to the crowd,

"I didn't destroy you! Why are you mentioning my father?"

"Keep talking, or my father will take you all to see the mountain god!"

"Hey, look at this little vixen."

The mean woman showed no sign of weakness and spat, saying, "You are just as charming as your short-lived mother! I see, your father and mother are the ones who killed this little broom star of yours!"

"Next time, I will kill you!"

The girl's eyes were red and she didn't give in.

"Get away from me!"

From behind the crowd, a man suddenly walked out.

The person who came was a strong man, wearing a suit of Iron Li Army leather armor, and had a cold expression.

"Let's go, let's go! It's not as lively as you guys can see!"

As soon as the onlookers saw this man, their expressions changed. They didn't dare to say anything anymore and dispersed one after another.

As soon as the girl saw the visitor, her tight, angry little face suddenly softened.

The circles under his eyes also turned red.

"Uncle Hagu..."

"I just returned to the city, and I heard some noise outside the city."

Hagu sullenly walked into the yard.

He walked to Shi Deaf and squatted down, picking up a piece of gravel.

"Master! Why did you collapse the stone again?"

Hagu's voice was a bit annoyed as he said, "Didn't you promise me that you would never touch this thing again?"

"Look, I'm done!"

Shi Deaf didn't seem to hear what he was saying at all, he just held up the gravel in his hand and yelled at him.

"It's no use even if it's done!"

Hagu put down the gravel in his hand and said word by word,

"Mountains have bones, stones have souls, and each chisel is used to respect the mountain god. Three points of respect, one inch given, one piece taken, and one thank you. Isn't this what you taught me sentence by sentence?"

"Use gunpowder to break the bones of the mountain to anger the mountain god!"
